description: This file defines utility functions and data structures for managing team permissions and roles within a project, including role hierarchy, permission checks, and building permission maps.

methods.name: hasHigherPrivilege
methods.description: Determines if one role has higher privilege than another based on hierarchy.

methods.name: getEffectiveRole
methods.description: Returns the higher privilege role between organization membership and individual membership role.

methods.name: getTeamPermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions for a user on a specific team, with fallback logic if permission retrieval fails.

methods.name: getFallbackPermissions
methods.description: Provides default permissions based on role when permission retrieval fails.

methods.name: buildTeamPermissionsMap
methods.description: Builds a map of team IDs to permissions for a user based on memberships and roles.
